body:
R11 SOURCE-CHECKED REFINEMENT — sorting the Accepted evidence union is necessary but not sufficient.

On current source, EvidenceBundle.proposals is an order-sensitive Vector (resolve.scala:253-260); LedgerEntry embeds that whole bundle (:359-364); CandidateLedger preserves append order (:369-406). R4.6 simultaneously requires the complete proposal bundle to be identity-bearing. Therefore a future construction checksum can remain proposal-order dependent even after collect sorts leading.evidence. The R11 court must reach the whole identity-bearing artifact, not stop at ResolutionState equality.

Publish two distinct records:

1. RAW ACQUISITION TRACE: may retain wall-clock/arrival sequence for audit, with a trace identity. It is not scientific evidence and cannot select a cut.
2. CANONICAL SCIENTIFIC INPUT PROJECTION: contains every proposal, finding, calibration, call-group identity and dependency fact, but is canonically ordered/versioned by stable content or receipt keys. Resolver state and complete-construction identity bind to this projection. A permutation changes the trace, not the projection or decision.

COURT R11 must reverse both proposal order and inline evidence order, then require equality of: canonical input projection, full resolved state, complete-construction identity, and output. The raw trace is the intentional negative control and may differ. A retry/clone may change the trace and observed multiset, but after declared call/dependence grouping it MUST NOT create independent support or posterior mass.

This also reconciles R4.6 with permutation invariance: complete means no proposal is discarded; it does not mean arrival sequence becomes scientific identity. Canonicalizing only evidenceId leaves the larger Vector door open. The canonicalization rule and version belong in the serialized-artifact contract before R3/M4, otherwise codec iteration/order becomes an undocumented estimator.

No implementation, public vocabulary, codec choice, path, bead, or authority claimed.
